statement: Linux v7.3 direct 1302 hid-steam and SDL Triton direct 1302 paths do not check a physical USB parent or interface number. Public InputPlumber evidence of a Steam 1205 interface gate cannot be promoted to 1302. Valve udev grants hidraw device access; D9 Steam hidraw open means access was achieved but cannot rule out a separate USB metadata criterion. Bootloader-first is operator-reported, not a demonstrated Steam enumeration prerequisite.
